pharma.title: Eli Lilly launches Lormalzi for early Alzheimer’s treatment in India
pharma.summary: Eli Lilly has officially launched Lormalzi in India, marking the introduction of the country's first targeted therapy for early-stage Alzheimer's disease.

pharma.title: Drug Regulator To Meet Pharma Industry To Review High-Risk Solvents In Cough Syrups
pharma.summary: India's central drug regulator announced a meeting with pharmaceutical manufacturers to strictly evaluate and regulate the use of high-risk solvents in cough syrup formulations.

pharma.title: Indian Pharmacopoeia Commission Signs MoUs With Bihar, Maharashtra And Mizoram State Pharmacy Councils
pharma.summary: The Indian Pharmacopoeia Commission signed agreements with state pharmacy councils in Bihar, Maharashtra, and Mizoram to strengthen pharmacovigilance and adverse reaction reporting.

pharma.title: Over 12 lakh chemists across India hold nationwide strike
pharma.summary: More than 1.2 million chemists across India staged a nationwide strike to highlight regulatory concerns and operational grievances in the retail pharmacy sector.

national.title: Explained: Why India Raised Gold Import Duty
national.summary: The Union government increased import duties on gold to manage current account pressure and curb non-essential foreign exchange outflows.

national.title: States announce measures to save fuel following PM's appeal
national.summary: State governments across India initiated fuel-saving measures, including downsizing official vehicle convoys and restricting non-essential official foreign travel.

international.title: Global health gains face threat of reversal - World Health Organization
international.summary: The World Health Organization warned that decades of global public health progress face severe threats of reversal due to emerging socio-economic and crisis pressures.

international.title: South African Minister Lamola arrives in India for BRICS Foreign Ministers’ Meeting
international.summary: South African International Relations Minister Ronald Lamola arrived in India to participate in the BRICS Foreign Ministers' Meeting.

international.title: Russian FM reassures India on energy supply stability
international.summary: Russia's Foreign Minister affirmed that India's energy security and market interests will remain protected despite volatile global energy market conditions.

economy.title: Rupee hits all-time low of 95.74 against US Dollar
economy.summary: The Indian Rupee depreciated to a record low of 95.74 per US Dollar as elevated crude oil prices weighed heavily on domestic currency markets.

economy.title: India’s economic strength defies foreign outflow fears, S&P Says
economy.summary: S&P Global Ratings highlighted that India's fundamental economic resilience continues to buffer it against capital outflow risks.

economy.title: RBI Governor comments on West Asia shock and monetary stance
economy.summary: RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra stated that the Monetary Policy Committee will look through West Asia geopolitical supply shocks if temporary, though prolonged conflict could force fuel price adjustments.

science.title: 10,000 more UG, PG medical seats by 2029: Health Minister at AIIMS Convocation
science.summary: Union Health Minister J.P. Nadda announced at the 51st AIIMS New Delhi convocation that 10,000 additional medical undergraduate and postgraduate seats will be added by 2029.

science.title: Generic Ozempic expansion set for international markets
science.summary: More affordable generic versions of the GLP-1 drug Ozempic are reaching global healthcare markets outside the United States as patents expire.

environment.title: Environment Ministry to highlight big cat conservation and IBCA goals
environment.summary: The Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change announced nationwide programs to showcase India's big cat conservation milestones and promote International Big Cat Alliance objectives.

environment.title: Kerala releases comprehensive environmental history encyclopaedia
environment.summary: Kerala published a multi-volume encyclopedia documenting the state's historical ecological shifts, conservation movements, and environmental milestones.

environment.title: Focus on Uttarakhand’s indigenous water management in climate plans
environment.summary: Climate experts advocated incorporating Uttarakhand's traditional, community-based water knowledge systems into national climate adaptation strategies.

sports.title: Jhulan Goswami praises Bengal Pro T20 League for women's cricket
sports.summary: Legendary Indian cricketer Jhulan Goswami highlighted the Bengal Pro T20 League as a key grassroot platform for developing women's cricket in India.

sports.title: English Premier League deepens grassroots coaching initiatives in India
sports.summary: The English Premier League expanded its India footprint with specialized grassroots football coaching programs aimed at youth talent development.

awards_honours.title: New York Governor honours Indian chef Vikas Khanna
awards_honours.summary: The Governor of New York State presented a special honor to Indian celebrity chef Vikas Khanna for his contributions to global culinary art and culture.

awards_honours.title: Shahid Afridi conferred with Hilal-e-Imtiaz in Pakistan
awards_honours.summary: Former cricket captain Shahid Afridi became the fourth cricketer in Pakistan to be awarded the prestigious Hilal-e-Imtiaz civilian honor.

awards_honours.title: President Murmu confers national award on Chandigarh’s Nightingale
awards_honours.summary: President Droupadi Murmu presented a national award to Chandigarh's acclaimed veteran vocalist, popular as 'Chandigarh's Nightingale'.

defence.title: India’s first privately built military aircraft C-295 ready in Gujarat
defence.summary: The first privately manufactured C-295 military transport aircraft produced by Tata Advanced Systems in Gujarat is ready for official rollout.

defence.title: Chinese intelligence ship tracks Agni-5 MIRV missile test
defence.summary: An Indian Ocean deployment of a Chinese intelligence gathering vessel was observed monitoring India's Agni-5 MIRV missile flight test.

defence.title: Rajnath Singh to visit Vietnam and South Korea for defence talks
defence.summary: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh scheduled official diplomatic visits to Vietnam and South Korea to strengthen Indo-Pacific maritime security ties.

schemes_appointments.title: West Bengal govt to launch Annapurna Bhandar scheme from June 1
schemes_appointments.summary: The West Bengal state government announced the rollout of the 'Annapurna Bhandar' social assistance welfare scheme offering Rs 3,000 monthly aid starting June 1.

schemes_appointments.title: West Bengal offers free public bus travel for women
schemes_appointments.summary: West Bengal became the 8th state in India to launch free bus travel facilities for women aboard state-run transport buses.

schemes_appointments.title: Sunil Bharti Mittal re-appointed Chairman of Bharti Airtel
schemes_appointments.summary: The Board of Directors of Bharti Airtel approved the re-appointment of founder Sunil Bharti Mittal as Chairman for another five-year term.

important_days.title: International Nurses Day observed globally
important_days.summary: Healthcare institutions globally marked International Nurses Day to honor the role, compassion, and contributions of nursing staff in global health.

mcqs.q: Which pharmaceutical company launched 'Lormalzi', India's first drug specifically for early-stage Alzheimer's treatment, in May 2026?
mcqs.explanation: Eli Lilly launched Lormalzi in India as the country's first therapeutic drug targeting early-stage Alzheimer's disease.

mcqs.q: To what all-time low value did the Indian Rupee fall against the US Dollar on 13 May 2026 due to oil price pressures?
mcqs.explanation: On 13 May 2026, high global crude oil prices dragged the Indian Rupee down to a historical low of 95.74 per US Dollar.

mcqs.q: India's first privately manufactured military transport aircraft, the C-295, has been built by Tata in which state?
mcqs.explanation: The C-295 military aircraft, India's first privately built defense plane, was manufactured by Tata Advanced Systems in Gujarat.

mcqs.q: Which state announced the launch of the 'Annapurna Bhandar' scheme offering financial support of Rs 3,000 starting June 1, 2026?
mcqs.explanation: West Bengal announced the launch of the Annapurna Bhandar scheme providing Rs 3,000 financial support starting June 1.

mcqs.q: The Indian Pharmacopoeia Commission (IPC) signed MoUs with the State Pharmacy Councils of which three states in May 2026 to boost drug safety?
mcqs.explanation: IPC signed strategic MoUs with Bihar, Maharashtra, and Mizoram State Pharmacy Councils to strengthen drug safety and pharmacovigilance.
